notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Grafted Wargear attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with Grafted Wargear attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.
